note: Every behaviour case of the Node test, mapped to the fixture ids that now own it in Rust. The fixture-shape test reads the Node test file and fails when a test title is missing here; it is retired together with the Node test when the Node door moves to the native addon.

tests.title: mappings, sequences and scalars parse to plain values
malformed input throws an error naming the file, the line and the column
empty, whitespace-only and comment-only input return null, as do a bare document marker and ~
more than one document throws, naming the file and the count
core schema: yes/no/on/off and an unquoted ISO date stay strings, << is an ordinary key
an alias bomb throws once aliases pass the limit, flat or nested
aliases within the limit still resolve
a self-referencing map is refused as an endless expansion and does not hang
nested aliases under the alias limit still throw when they expand past the value budget
a large flat document under the value budget parses
__proto__ and constructor.prototype keys become own keys and never reach Object.prototype
indented block mappings and whitespace-only block scalars parse as the YAML spec intends
the vendored js-yaml file is byte-identical to the release it names
tests.retired: It tests a file that disappears with the vendored js-yaml bundle; the crate replaces it with its own pinned parser and upgrade record.
